content:
keira: Deploybot put a hold on prod promotion for release-817. publish-check: attestation copy missing in target account after mirror. change window is open but only 25m left.

deploybot: publish-check FAIL: attestation-not-found for arn:aws:ecr:eu-west-1:222333444555:repository/release-817@sha256:1122aabb. Mirror reported 403 when uploading attestation blob. See runbook: https://go/runbooks/attestation-copy

infra-jenkins: mirror job logs: `403 AccessDenied` on attest blob put, layers pushed OK. It looks like the mirror role lost `ecr:PutImageScanFindings`/`ecr:PutImage` on the attestation prefix after yesterday's permission tidy.

sam: product note: they prefer not to delay. If we manual-cosign in target account we can approve, but we must record operator and reason. is that acceptable?

pm: product ok with manual cosign if it's documented. prefer to fix role and requeue if that can be done within the window.

ops-bot: alert: mirror-runner role change PR stalled in CI for unrelated lint. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1107

keira: quick options:
- fix role -> requeue mirror job (preferred, preserves original attestation provenance)
- manual cosign in target account + deploybot approve (audit note)
- promote by digest and attach a synthetic attestation (not recommended)

sam: ETA on role fix? I can repush the PR with lint fixes in ~10m. If CI passes, mirror requeue should finish <15m.

infra-jenkins: CI restarted for PR 1107. watching.

keira: product gives us 20m. if CI not green by 20m we do manual cosign. I'll prepare the release-note text in case. Draft: "Publish delayed briefly while attestation copy to target account was restored; manual attestation avoided."

ops-bot: CI passed and PR merged. role permissions updated. requeuing mirror job: `kubectl -n infra exec mirror-runner -- /mirror --repo release-817 --retry`

infra-jenkins: mirror job completed and attestation uploaded.

deploybot: publish-check re-run -> PASS. Attestation found: cosign://ecr/eu-west-1/release-817@sha256:1122aabb. Promotion allowed.

sam: rolling canary now. release notes message approved by product.

keira: post-action: add infra lint that blocks role permission tidy PRs without an attestation-perms smoke test, and add deploybot telemetry to report attestation-copy failures per region. filing tickets: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/1622 and https://github.com/redwood/platform/issues/789

pm: thanks team. closing this thread and moving notes to #postmortems if we need a formal write-up. :white_check_mark:
